text:
alex: Heads up — final transfer window for Capitol Cup closes in ~45 mins. I need a last-minute swap, injured striker out. :sweat_smile:
jing: oh no who?
alex: Raul Sanchez (HAM) — twisted ankle in warm-up. thinking about dropping him for M. Okoye (MID) or keeping him on the bench
sam: bench? Okoye's been quiet last 3 weeks
nora: I'd pick Okoye if you're chasing goals. He's on set pieces next match. :eyes:
tim: quick poll — should alex swap in Okoye or play conservative? react with :one: for Okoye, :two: for bench
alex: vote plz — already submitted for auto-pick if I don't respond
jing: :one:
nora: :one: and I'm bringing snacks for the watch party at 6pm? @tim
tim: count me in. I'll bring chips. :metal:
sam: If anyone's going to the rooftop, FYI there's capacity limit 12. RSVP or we'll livestream in the kitchen.
alex: thanks. Also thinking about bench order — here's my 3 players:
```
1. Raul Sanchez (OUT)
2. M. Okoye (SUB)
3. J. Ortega (FWD)
```
any objections?
nora: swap Okoye in for Raul. Ortega can rotate.
sam: also, if Okoye doesn't start, set captain to Ortega. :point_up:
alex: done. changed captain to Ortega. fingers crossed.
ops-bot: Reminder: office rooftop booking confirmed 6:00–9:00 PM. Event: Capitol Cup Watch. :calendar:
tim: perfect. See y'all there. :beers:
alex: thanks team. Also kudos to @nora for the hot take that paid off last week :trophy:
nora: lol tiny victories. :sparkles:
